unknowns_formerly_rules.was_constraint: C3: canvas click error tolerance is ±15px
unknowns_formerly_rules.now: Exact click tolerance UNKNOWN. One canvas click produced unexpected navigation (F2). Possible causes: coordinate mismatch, hitbox uncertainty, state-transition timing. Exact tolerance never measured — a calibration pass is required before any number is stated.
Time-lapse between observation and click is a PLAUSIBLE contributing factor to F2 but was not isolated. The rule is a reasonable precaution, not an evidence-proven tolerance.

runtime_candidates.statement: After a post-action observation tool failure (e.g. screenshot timeout), the pending transaction must be reconciled against the next fresh stable state before any retry of the pending action; observation-tool failure must not be read as transaction-pending and must not trigger a blind re-click.
runtime_candidates.origin: 2026-09-06 live run: screenshot pipeline hung after SCHEDULE:VOCAL click while the game committed the week (8->7); operator fresh visual evidence reconciled the boundary
runtime_candidates.status: PROVISIONAL — n=1 occurrence; runtime candidate only, Harness NOT changed
